t: According to the traditions of the Yoruba religion, Ife was the first city, built on the earth that Oduduwa cast on the primordial ocean, and the kingdoms of Ila Orangun, Owu, Ketu, Egba, Ijesha, Oyo and others were founded by his descendants.

The city was founded between 1000 and 500 BCE, was an important West African emporium by 900 CE, and reached a classical period in the 1100s in which its artists made naturalistic sculpture in terracotta, stone and copper alloy.
Production of that art declined after about 1400 as political and economic power shifted to Benin, but Ife remained the seat of the Ọọ̀ni and, in tradition, the city of 401 deities.
dyk: Ife glass beads have been found at sites as far away as Mali, Mauritania and Ghana, and Igbo Olokun may be one of the earliest glass-making workshops in West Africa.
ev: Ife is an important West African emporium producing sophisticated art forms
Glass production at Igbo Olokun may have begun, if not earlier
Ife enters a classical period and becomes the capital of a significant regional empire
Ife's naturalistic bronze, stone and terracotta sculpture reaches its peak
Artists at Ife develop a refined naturalistic tradition, many works made under King Obalufon II
The glass-making technology of the Yoruba persists in Osun Grove
The Yoruba Orisha Congress is formed, and the Ọọ̀ni gains an international standing

f.founded: Between 1000 BCE and 500 BCE. In Yoruba tradition the city was founded by order of the Supreme Deity Olódùmarè, and the earth on which it stands was made by Oduduwa.
f.where: In Osun State in south-western Nigeria, about 218 kilometres north-east of Lagos, in a tropical savanna zone of undulating land, about 40 km from Osogbo.
f.known: The Yoruba account of the creation of the world; the dynasty of Oduduwa and the Ọọ̀ni; the city of 401 deities and its festivals; naturalistic bronze, stone and terracotta sculpture; glass beads from Igbo Olokun; iron smelting
f.today: Ife is a city in Osun State, Nigeria, the seat of the Ọọ̀ni of Ifẹ̀ and the site of Obafemi Awolowo University.
